Recruiters Warn Iced Coffee in Interviews May Cost Jobs

Recruiters and hiring experts are divided over the trend of bringing iced coffee to job interviews, with some warning it could negatively impact a candidate's chances. The debate centers on changing workplace norms, with the "iced coffee habit" potentially signaling a disconnect with professional expectations, according to some experts.
